title: Rippling Review (2026)
intro: Rippling is evaluated here as a unified people platform (HR + payroll + IT modules) — Rippling is a unified workforce platform spanning HRIS, payroll, benefits, time, recruiting, plus native IT (devices/SSO) and spend on one employee system of record. The published SMB floor is $8/user/mo plus a $40/mo base fee for core platform access; payroll, benefits, IT, spend, and EOR modules stack PEPM and are largely quote-led. No free plan or self-serve trial — demo / free quote. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Rippling when you want HR, payroll, and IT on one employee record and will model stacked PEPM — not when you only need simple US payroll or a dedicated ATS.
verdict: Choose Rippling when you want HR, payroll, and IT on one employee record and will model stacked PEPM — not when you only need simple US payroll or a dedicated ATS. Compare BambooHR for a simpler core HRIS, Gusto for payroll-first SMB buying, Greenhouse for structured hiring, and Workday for enterprise HCM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Powerful modular platform with more setup than BambooHR or Gusto. Score reflects breadth versus a simple payroll-first UI — not hands-on lab testing.
Primary job is people-platform: HR + payroll + IT on one employee record. Scored inside that cluster, not as a dedicated ATS or frontline WFM.
Hire-to-device-to-pay workflows are the product thesis. Recruiting and time exist as modules; depth is strongest as a unified employee graph.
650+ apps plus native device/app provisioning is category-leading ecosystem depth for a people platform.
Employee/manager mobile and time exist; not a deskless scheduling specialist. Scored for people-platform mobility.
Workforce reporting across HR/IT/spend is a published strength versus single-module HRIS tools.
Modular PEPM and global/EOR paths support growth from SMB into mid-market; enterprise HCM is still a different shortlist.
Published $8 floor is misleading versus stacked TCO. Held at 6 for packaging opacity. Affiliate economics excluded.
Ask Rippling AI is marketed across workforce data — useful assistant story with quote-gated packaging.

faq.question: Is Rippling HR / workforce software?
faq.answer: Yes. Rippling is evaluated as a unified people platform (HR + payroll + IT modules).

faq.question: How is Rippling priced?

faq.question: Does Rippling have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. No free trial is documented on the pricing page. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Rippling?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
